- Initial release of the Discord Bulk Message Delete skill.
- Provides a Python script for deleting multiple messages in a Discord channel, with no npm/discord.js dependency (standard library only).
- Supports bulk deletion, handling Discord’s API limit of 100 messages per request automatically.
- Flexible command-line usage, including custom message counts and channel selection.
- Detailed documentation included for setup, permissions, usage examples, and troubleshooting.
